title: Make Your Accomplishments Seem Effortless
coreMove: Hide the scaffolding so the finished act carries authority without visible strain
sourcePressure: Chapter 30 centers on making accomplishment look easy even when it required deep labor, rehearsal, and design. The law values polished execution because visible strain, clutter, and exposed scaffolding can reduce mystique, authority, and persuasive force. Its limit is that concealment can become deception when the hidden work turns into false claims, manipulated credit, or dishonesty about what actually happened. Frozen sidecar provides no traceable named anecdote for this chapter; do not fabricate named source anchors.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: lying about effort or pretending to be magical
